intent: Compare the Infections series against the Healthcare capacity reference across the relative time window to determine whether Infections remains below capacity.

Compare the Infections series against the Healthcare capacity reference across the relative time window to determine whether Infections remains below capacity.

units.claim: All 2 required area marks are present in the chart: Infections, Healthcare capacity.
accept: every listed area, reference mark, segment, or category is visible

reject: missing any required area, reference mark, segment, or category

units.claim: The Infections series remains below the Healthcare capacity reference line throughout the relative time window, with its maximum value (31.78) staying under the capacity threshold (33.47).
accept: Infections peak is below the capacity line

reject: Infections exceeds the capacity threshold at any point

Infections peaks at approximately 31.78 relative units around x=0.496.
Healthcare capacity is constant at approximately 33.47 relative units across the window.
